cues: At a melting or boiling point the change is reversible, so delta S is delta H over T. Melting ice: six thousand and ten over two seventy three, twenty two joules per kelvin per mole.
Boiling water: forty thousand seven hundred over three seventy three, one hundred and nine.
And the third law: a perfect crystal at absolute zero has zero entropy, which gives entropy an absolute scale.
text: At a melting or boiling point the change is reversible, so delta S is delta H over T. Melting ice: six thousand and ten over two seventy three, twenty two joules per kelvin per mole. Boiling water: forty thousand seven hundred over three seventy three, one hundred and nine. Boiling creates far more disorder. And the third law: a perfect crystal at absolute zero has zero entropy, which gives entropy an absolute scale.
